messages:
jordan: Quick heads-up — security scan flagged a transitive vuln in kms-client (CVE-2026-XXXX). Potential token parsing issue. No public PoC yet but NVD scores it as CVSS 7.0. Need patch priority and rollout plan for hosted + managed Dedicated pools.
maya: @jordan thanks. Do we know surface area? public endpoints or only internal services?
sam: no public PoC. Attack requires crafted token input that only our internal token-exchange accepts. Main blast radius: backend services and any third-party connectors that pass tokens. Hosted API customer requests look low risk but still non-zero.
lee: note — Private/on-prem customers manage their own runtime, so patches not pushed there. Dedicated-managed (our infra) is in-scope.
maya: SLA impact question — if we do rolling restarts to swap lib, will that trigger downtime or just latency blips?
arjun: rolling replacement should be safe. Expect transient latency bump ~50-200ms during reconnects. No full outage if we do staged canaries. Also recommend enabling extended KMS audit logging for 24h post-rollout to catch anomalies.
sam: agree on canary. Suggested plan: canary 10% for 15m -> 25% for 30m -> 50% -> full. If errors spike >1% or p50 latency >500ms rollback. Owner: @sam for PR + deploy.
deploy-bot: proposed schedule: canary 2026-04-02T02:00Z, staged roll 2026-04-02T05:00Z. Automated rollback hooks set. Trigger: manual approve by security lead.
maya: approve schedule. Also: we should notify Gold/Enterprise customers (Dedicated gold) proactively — they'd expect earlier notice and may want to opt for immediate maintenance windows.
lee: Confirming Private customers unaffected. For Dedicated-managed, we should set maintenance window and notify via status and direct email. Also add note to support playbook: how to interpret KMS audit spikes.
jordan: decision actions: 1) sam -> open patch PR and run CI 2) arjun -> enable `redwood.audit.kms=true` for post-rollout monitoring 3) maya -> draft customer comm for Gold customers + status page update 4) lee -> update support playbook and staging checklist 5) deploy-bot -> schedule canary and roll steps. Target: within 48h. OK?
maya: OK. I'll start comms draft now. :white_check_mark:
sam: PR opened: https://git.redwood/repos/kms-client/pulls/42 — tests passing locally, integration tests queued. Will request canary deploy once green. cc @deploy-bot
deploy-bot: canary initiated at 2026-04-02T02:00Z on 10% nodes. Monitoring hooks: kms.audit, error-rate, latency.
arjun: audit toggle on for canary. Watching logs; ingestion +3.6% — within expected.
jordan: excellent. If we see any regression we rollback with: `./deploy rollback --tag v1.12.3` — keep updates in this thread."
